L66: Solstice Advance Materials and Qnity Electronics Set to Join S&P 500; Others to Join S&P SmallCap 600
L67: 
L68:   *   *   *   *   *   *   * NEW YORK, Oct. 27, 2025 /【37†PRNewswire†www.prnewswire.com】/ -- S&P Dow Jones Indices will make the following changes to the S&P 500, S&P SmallCap 600:
L69:   * Solstice Advance Materials Inc. (NASD: SOLS) will replace CarMax Inc. (NYSE: KMX) in the S&P 500, and CarMax will replace USANA Health Sciences Inc. (NYSE: USNA) in the S&P SmallCap 600 effective prior to the opening of trading on Friday, October 31. S&P 500 and 100 constituent Honeywell International Inc. (NASD: HON) is spinning off Solstice Advance Materials in a transaction expected to be completed on October 30. Post spin-off, Honeywell International will remain in the S&P 500 and 100.
L70: CarMax and USANA Health Sciences no longer represent the large cap and small cap market space, respectively.
L71:   * Qnity Electronics Inc. (NYSE:Q) will replace Eastman Chemical Co. (NYSE: EMN) in the S&P 500, and Eastman Chemical will replace Caleres Inc. (NYSE: CAL) in the S&P SmallCap 600 effective prior to the opening of trading on Tuesday, November 4. S&P 500 constituent Dupont de Nemours Inc. (NYSE:DD) is spinning off Qnity Electronics in a transaction expected to be completed on November 3. Post spin-off, Dupont de Nemours will remain in the S&P 500.
L72: Eastman Chemical and Caleres no longer represent the large cap and small cap market space, respectively.
L73: Following is a summary of the changes that will take place prior to the open of trading on the effective date:
L74: Effective Date  | Index Name        | Action  | Company Name  | Ticker  | GICS Sector
L75: Oct 30, 2025  | S&P 500  | Addition  | Solstice Advance Materials  | SOLS  | Materials
L76: Oct 31, 2025  | S&P 500  | Deletion  | CarMax  | KMX  | Consumer Discretionary
L77: Oct 31, 2025  | S&P SmallCap 600  | Addition  | CarMax  | KMX  | Consumer Discretionary
L78: Oct 31, 2025  | S&P SmallCap 600  | Deletion  | USANA Health Sciences  | USNA  | Consumer Staples
L79: Nov 3, 2025  | S&P 500  | Addition  | Qnity Electronics  | Q  | Information Technology
L80: Nov 4, 2025  | S&P 500  | Deletion  | Eastman Chemical Co  | EMN  | Materials
L81: Nov 4, 2025  | S&P SmallCap 600  | Addition  | Eastman Chemical Co  | EMN  | Materials
L82: Nov 4, 2025  | S&P SmallCap 600  | Deletion  | Caleres Inc  | CAL  | Consumer Discretionary

L89: ABOUT S&P DOW JONES INDICES
L90: S&P Dow Jones Indices is the largest global resource for essential index-based concepts, data and research, and home to iconic financial market indicators, such as the S&P 500® and the Dow Jones Industrial Average®. More assets are invested in products based on our indices than products based on indices from any other provider in the world.
L91: Since Charles Dow invented the first index in 1884, S&P DJI has been innovating and developing indices across the spectrum of asset classes helping to define the way investors measure and trade the markets.
